In-Depth Guide

Many newcomers may blindly chase the Royal Guard's Claymore for its sky-high listed attack, but veterans know that blade is reserved for mounting a Lynel's back to attack (which costs no durability). When it comes to the best all-round value for everyday overworld travel, fighting above your level, chopping trees and cutting grass, and sustained damage, nothing beats Urbosa's keepsake — the Scimitar of the Seven! This hardcore illustrated guide will walk you through crafting this pinnacle of Hyrule's infinite-upkeep playstyle, step by step!

一、为什么七宝匕首是当之无愧的"日常战神"？
1. Why Is the Scimitar of the Seven the Undisputed “Everyday War God”?
普通的格鲁德武器虽然也有"强力组合"词条（让装上去的材料攻击力翻倍），但是有一个致命的负面 BUFF——掉耐久掉得极快，砍两下就碎了。然而，作为英杰武器的「七宝匕首」却完美避开了这个坑！

Ordinary Gerudo weapons also carry the “Powerful Fuse” trait (which doubles the attack of the fused material), but they have a fatal downside — their durability drains extremely fast, and they shatter after a couple of swings. The Scimitar of the Seven, however, as a Champion's weapon, sidesteps that pitfall completely!

三、详细获取与合成步骤（手把手保姆级教学）
3. Detailed Steps to Obtain and Forge It (A Hand-Holding, Nanny-Level Tutorial)
解锁"英杰武器铸造资格"
Unlock “Champion Weapon Forging Access”
首先必须通关主线任务【格鲁德小镇的雷之神殿】，帮露珠女王解决木乃伊危机。随后前往格鲁德小镇的珠宝店，接取支线任务【行踪不定的老板】。带上几支炸弹箭，前往小镇西边的卢玛琳沙地，把"莫尔德拉吉克"（沙兽）干掉，救出珠宝店老板。回到小镇，找工匠玛卡利萨对话，正式开启英杰武器铸造服务。

First, you must clear the main quest [Lightning Temple of Gerudo Town] and help Queen Riju resolve the mummy crisis. Then head to the jewelry shop in Gerudo Town and accept the side quest [The Missing Owner]. Bring a few Bomb Arrows, go to the Toruma Dunes west of town, take down the Molduga (the sand beast), and rescue the jewelry shop owner. Return to town and talk to the artisan Makalisa to officially unlock Champion weapon forging.

Remove the Expensive Material (Optional) — Head to Tarrey Town
如果七宝匕首上已经粘了白银人马的刃角，直接修复会将其覆盖。建议先去塔尔里镇（一卡拉村）找小鼓隆族NPC帕黎恩，花20卢比把材料完好地拆下来放进背包。

If a Silver Lynel Saber Horn is already fused to your Scimitar of the Seven, repairing it directly will overwrite it. First go to Tarrey Town (in the Akkala region) and find Pelison, the young Goron NPC, and spend 20 Rupees to have the material removed intact into your inventory.

装备一把普通武器在手（旅人剑、骑士盾等）。把红血快碎的七宝匕首丢在地上，使用"余料建造"技能，将七宝匕首作为配件粘在普通武器上。

Equip an ordinary weapon in hand (a Traveler's Sword, a Knight's Shield, etc.). Drop the red-health, nearly broken Scimitar of the Seven on the ground, use the “Fuse” ability, and fuse the Scimitar of the Seven onto the ordinary weapon as an attachment.

Feed It to a Rock Octorok — Head to the Eldin Region
带着组合好的"连体武器"前往死亡山脉寻找岩石章鱼。把武器丢在它面前，等它吸入并冒出亮晶晶修复特效后，在它吐出来时立刻捡起。此时，基础武器和上面的七宝匕首会同时回满耐久！

Carry the combined “fused-together weapon” to Death Mountain to find a Rock Octorok. Drop the weapon in front of it, wait for it to suck it in and produce a sparkling repair effect, then pick it up the moment it spits it out. At that point, both the base weapon and the Scimitar of the Seven on top will have their durability fully restored at the same time!
